description.p: Lexicon is a small, native dictionary utility for KDE Plasma. It looks up English words in a local SQLite dictionary and presents definitions in a focused popup.

The application is offline-first, starts without a visible window, and stays out of the way until invoked by a global shortcut or the tray icon. Selected text is read from the Wayland primary selection on KWin; X11 reports an explicit unsupported error instead of falling back to the clipboard.

Lexicon ships a WordNet 3.0 dictionary with CMUdict pronunciations, supports IPA or respelling display, and can optionally translate through a local Argos Translate pack that the user installs explicitly over HTTPS. The settings window edits `config.toml`, manages opt-in autostart, and controls the bounded lookup cache.
Initial scaffold with configuration, SQLite lookup, KGlobalAccel registration, tray integration, and QML popup.
